name: Selected Deck Highlight
author: hleawilliams-commits
summary: Bright deck numbers and panel edges show which decks the left and right controls select.
description: Emulator preview for the 4 DECK waveform layout. Reads the native deck-select LED output: left 1/3 and right 2/4. Selected deck numbers turn cyan and their lower info panels get a cyan top edge. Independent of PLAY and MASTER. Hides on other layouts or unknown/stale selection. No controls, audio, library writes or firmware hooks. Disable Selected deck highlight to restore stock indicators.
